auth.welcome_subtitle: Sign in to continue your health journey.
auth.superadmin_hint: Signing in with an Overstein admin email unlocks Super Admin.
onboarding.page1_body: Track heart rate, sleep, weight, and nutrition in one calm dashboard.
onboarding.page2_body: Medications, doctor visits, labs, vaccinations, and records — organized.
onboarding.page3_body: Ask SuperHealth Mate for orientation, and keep a secure emergency card ready.
onboarding.consent_body: Choose what Super Health may store. Nothing is shared with AI unless you later select a record.
onboarding.consent_local: Store my health records on this device
dashboard.offline_banner: You are offline. Showing cached health data.
dashboard.missing_data: Some days have no measurements yet — gaps are left empty, never scored.
features.profile_sub: Units and preferences — no national ID
trends.gap_policy: Missing intervals are not filled with lines. Source is shown on every point.
sharing.disclaimer: Exports include only categories you choose. Revoke anytime. Audit logs actions without clinical values.
caregivers.default_no_full_access: Invites grant zero fields by default unless you pick them. Full vault access is never the default.
caregivers.empty_body: Invite a caregiver or dependent with an explicit field list.
wearable.demo_banner: Demo adapter — not a connected HealthKit/Health Connect device.
timeline.empty_body: Add a measurement or note. This is a personal log, not a diagnosis.
timeline.disclaimer: Entries are your records. Source and time are shown; missing values are not scored.
emergency.disabled_body: It stays hidden until you enable it. Lock-screen fields need a separate consent.
vitals.title: Track
vitals.subtitle: Heart rate, weight, sleep, and nutrition shortcuts.
assistant.hint: Ask about labs, sleep, meds, emergency card…
assistant.disabled_body: The Health AI flag is currently off.
search.hint: Search meds, visits, labs, records, nutrition…
search.empty_body: Try another keyword from your health library.
notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.empty_body: New reminders and summaries will appear here.
membership.title: Membership
membership.ai_limited: Health AI is limited on this plan.
membership.ai_unlimited: Health AI is unlimited on this plan.
membership.superadmin_active: You are signed in as Super Admin.
settings.title: Settings
settings.analytics_subtitle: Helps improve SuperHealth. No medical records are sold.
privacy.title: Privacy & security
privacy.open_sub: Lock, consents, export, delete, access log
privacy.cloud_clarity: Device backup and cloud: records stay on this device by default. Cloud sync is optional, plan-gated, and never implied as a clinical archive.
privacy.ack_cloud: I understand on-device vs optional cloud storage
privacy.records_free: Personal health records are included on Free. Paid tiers add themes, unlimited Mate, care circle, and cloud sync — not the diary.
privacy.lock_hint: Stores a PIN in secure storage. OS biometric prompt plugs into the same flag later.
privacy.clear_signout: Clear local views when signing out
privacy.delete_confirm_body: This removes local health rows for this account. It cannot be undone on-device.
medication.empty_body: Add a name and the instruction exactly as given. The app never recalculates dose.
medication.disclaimer: Reminders log taken / skipped / snoozed only. This is not a dosing calculator.
medication.logged_snooze: Snoozed — reminder body stays private on lock screen
observations.empty_body: Add a value with unit, time, timezone, and source.
observations.disclaimer: Reference ranges are not personal medical thresholds.
habits.empty_body: Set a personal goal. Missed days are not judged.
habits.non_judgmental: Progress is yours — we never shame a broken streak.
appointments.empty_body: Add place, clinician, notes, and questions for your visit.
documents.empty_body: Photos and PDFs stay on-device until you export them.
profile.no_national_id: National ID and passport are never required.
emergency.default_off: Emergency card is off by default.
emergency.lock_screen_consent: Allow selected fields on lock screen
emergency.lock_screen_hint: Separate consent — off unless you turn it on
